title: Learning to accelerate Krasnosel'skii-Mann fixed-point iterations with guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2601.07665v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a principled learning to optimize (L2O) framework for solving fixed-point problems involving general nonexpansive mappings. Our idea is to deliberately inject summable perturbations into a standard Krasnosel'skii-Mann iteration to improve its average-case performance over a specific distribution of problems while retaining its convergence guarantees. Under a metric sub-regularity assumption, we prove that the proposed parametrization includes only iterations that locally achieve linear convergence-up to a vanishing bias term-and that it encompasses all iterations that do so at a sufficiently fast rate. We then demonstrate how our framework can be used to augment several widely-used operator splitting methods to accelerate the solution of structured monotone inclusion problems, and validate our approach on a best approximation problem using an L2O-augmented Douglas-Rachford splitting algorithm.

translated_title: 学习在保证收敛性的前提下加速Krasnosel'skii-Mann不动点迭代
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个有原则的“学习优化”（Learning to Optimize, L2O）框架，用于求解涉及一般非扩张映射的不动点问题。我们的想法是向标准的Krasnosel'skii-Mann迭代中刻意注入可求和的扰动，以提升其在特定问题分布上的平均情况性能，同时保留其收敛性保证。在度量次正则性假设下，我们证明了所提出的参数化仅包含那些在局部实现线性收敛的迭代（直至一个消失的偏差项），并且它涵盖了所有以足够快速率实现这一目标的迭代。随后，我们展示了如何利用该框架来增强几种广泛使用的算子分裂方法，以加速结构化单调包含问题的求解，并通过一个L2O增强的Douglas-Rachford分裂算法在最佳逼近问题上验证了我们的方法。
tldr: 本文提出一个学习优化框架，通过向Krasnosel'skii-Mann不动点迭代注入可求和扰动来提升其平均情况性能，同时在理论上保证局部线性收敛性，并可推广用于加速多种算子分裂方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a principled learning-to-optimize (L2O) framework that injects summable perturbations into Krasnosel'skii-Mann fixed-point iterations to improve average-case performance while provably retaining local linear convergence guarantees, and demonstrates its applicability to accelerating widely-used operator splitting methods.
